coherence_findings.issue: Fourteen of the nineteen carry `last_tested` and/or `last_gotcha` in frontmatter (RNBO carries both keys empty). SCHEMA — Reference.md:81 says these are not schema fields, nothing writes them, and each comes off its page when that page grows a tuning ledger; run-tests.mjs no longer writes them either. The Test Suite paragraph in each body repeats the same date in prose, so a page states when it last ran in two or three places that drift apart (Figure Rig: last_tested 2026-06-30 though its own Forward Vectors record work on 2026-07-01).
coherence_findings.proposed_action: No mass edit. Take the keys off each page in the same commit that gives it a tuning ledger (Kokoro, Whisper, ComfyUI first; they run most). RNBO's two empty keys can go now. Where a body says 'Last run: <date>', let the ledger's run lines carry it.

Maker: 'First job: a Sketch-tier deliverable through Kokoro'. ComfyUI: 'First job: a Sketch-tier exploration of the same brief FLUX (Hugging Face) runs first'. Kokoro: 'a 30-second Study-tier narration of a Floquet teaching paragraph' (the real first job was the Kuramoto narration). Whisper: the first job is the Kokoro round trip, which its Recipes record as done 2026-05-26. Matplotlib: 'a Bode plot' (its real first job was the Manim fallback). p5.js: 'a Study-tier interactive Kuramoto sketch' (landed 2026-05-10). Three.js: 'Landing it moves this entry stub → alive' while status already says alive. OBS shows the better pattern: '*See YAML `forward_vector`.*'. LaTeX and RNBO are still stubs and their first-job paragraphs are true.
coherence_findings.proposed_action: On the seven, replace the body section with OBS's one-line pointer, or delete it. Leave LaTeX and RNBO as they are until their first job lands.

summary: The Shop family of nineteen splits in two: the May pages (ComfyUI, Kokoro, Whisper, Matplotlib, p5.js, Three.js, VCV, RNBO, LaTeX) are full-anatomy templates, and the June-to-October pages (Blender, Depth Anything, Figure Rig, LoRA Trainer, OBS, Ableton Session Writer, Hero and Avatar Maker, Shopkeeper) are lean, each in its own way. The strongest finds are mechanical and checkable: Depth Anything, Figure Rig and OBS are absent from host-capability.json, so the Maker's own pre-dispatch check says 'not in the manifest' for them; Maker's heuristics never route to Depth Anything, Figure Rig, LoRA Trainer or OBS; ComfyUI still says ControlNet has never run though Blender, Figure Rig and RunPod all ran it through ComfyUI; Figure Rig contradicts itself on fingers; fourteen pages carry last_tested/last_gotcha that SCHEMA — Reference.md:81 says are not fields; seven alive pages end in stub-era 'First job' vectors; Shopkeeper names a tuning ledger that does not exist. On links, about nine pairs carry two edges where one is wanted (Kokoro/Whisper, Maker/RunPod, ComfyUI/RunPod and others), 'pairs-with' is used as a label five times, Matplotlib links a Plotly page that does not exist, and ControlNet Workflow Mastery and Capability-first prototyping are ghosts. I propose six typed relations (a spawned newcomer edge into Ableton Session Writer, new inbound for LoRA Trainer's ComfyUI role and for Depth Anything, three retypes) and cuts for RNBO->ffmpeg, VCV->Web Audio Worklet, Three.js->Shimmer Cloud and four of Hero's weaker edges. No compost: RNBO is the only candidate, and it is a question for Loudon, not a verdict. Memory: ledgers for Shopkeeper, Ableton Session Writer, Kokoro, LoRA Trainer; Contexts for Maker, Figure Rig, RunPod, OBS, Ableton, Hero; a scroll for Figure Rig. I found no genuine inbound from any member to Can an Instrument Notice Where the Work Stops? (Ableton's vector hints at it, but the Writer does not notice play), Operator Memory, AuK, CHILD, SCHEMA — Reference, or LDN RTM beyond OBS's existing edge, and left them out rather than force one.
